C0673.title: Lsky Pro Image Host Modification Guide: Removing Upload Restrictions and Adding Native Video Support
C0673.summary: A technical guide detailing how to modify the source code of Lsky Pro image hosting service to support all-format file uploads instead of images only, and to enable front-end video playback. The guide demonstrates how a normal image hosting service can be repurposed for video storage and playback, representing a typical technical implementation of image host abuse risks.
